patch.value: Rank lexical relevance, recency and standing guidance; entire packets stay within budget; process-concurrent recall counters; random-set property tests and packer revert proof.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Behavioral revert proof: revert only the packer acceptance predicate so oversized rows are accepted. npm run build passes; node --test --test-name-pattern="budget packer" test/memory.test.ts fails with AssertionError and exit 1. Restoring the predicate passes. Two independent processes start behind a shared barrier and produce exactly six recall increments.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Accepted aggregate recall packets stay under 800 estimated tokens. Four preselected references appeared at ranks 1, 1, 1 and 3; the release-workflow reference was omitted from its three returned rows. This budget tradeoff is documented rather than hidden. Index: 1498 of 1500 tokens. Random-set property and synchronized process-counter tests passed.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Recall now packs compact scored rows first, preserves top rank at small budgets, spends spare space on marked excerpts, and exposes full content via memory get. Ranking includes descriptions and slugs. Regression covers huge top bodies at budgets 200 and 800.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Behavioral revert proof: reverting only recall to the review baseline makes the 200-token top-1 regression fail (1 failed, 0 passed): a smaller fallback replaces the oversized highest-ranked memory. Restored code returns the top row and passes the focused suite.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Private ranking review exposed equal title/description weighting that buried a relevant reference. Adjusted weights to title 5, description 2, slug 1.5, other text 1; added a synthetic field-priority regression. Final five-query rank measurements pending.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Final private proof at budgets 800 and 200: reference ranks are 1,1,1,1,2 for the five prescribed queries at both budgets. Baseline replay ranks in packets were 1,1,omitted,1,2. Compact rows at 800 increased from 3 to 13; all packets fit, top-1 synthetic regression passes at 200. Index uses 1476/1500 estimated tokens. Aggregate table recorded in README.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Release-gate regression: scoring sampled Date.now independently for each memory. Advancing time during a ranking pass can incorrectly break a score tie before the slug tie-breaker. Capture one timestamp per pass; a real SDK memory plus a controlled advancing clock proves that equal-timestamp memories keep stable slug order. No SDK mocks.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Clock regression proof: the advancing-clock fixture passes with one timestamp per scoring pass, and fails with only scored reverted to b958419 (beta incorrectly precedes alpha). Both the direct and pm-linked regression pass after restoration. This removes the timing-dependent ranking failure without changing the tie contract.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Final verification: the advancing-clock regression is included in both isolated release gates, each passing 93/93 suite tests plus 2/2 packed npx/bunx consumers with 100/100/100/100 coverage. The scoring-only revert fails the regression; restored implementation passes. Release-gate timing failure resolved.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Extend existing recall with opt-in localhost Ollama embeddings, content-addressed runtime vectors, documented hybrid weights, budgeted lexical fallback notes, preview-only semantic duplicate proposals and a labelled synthetic retrieval benchmark. Preserve default lexical scores and pinned SDK version. Verify non-git execution, behavioural revert and unchanged npm/Bun release gates.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implemented loopback-only Ollama provider, deterministic no-model adapter and model-digest plus content-hash vector cache under runtime. Default stays lexical; explicit hybrid uses 30% normalized lexical score and 70% nonnegative cosine. Auto notes are included in token accounting. Synthetic corpus has 64 memories and 64 labelled queries. Initial embeddinggemma-2 measurement: lexical recall@1 0.203125, recall@5 0.5, MRR 0.332508; hybrid 0.28125, 0.625, 0.435186. These are full-ranking evaluation results, not budgeted or held-out generalization claims. Additional installed-model measurement and unchanged gates remain in progress.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Behavioural revert proof: replacing only hybridScored with the pre-feature lexical ranking makes node --test --test-name-pattern="hybrid ranking promotes paraphrases" test/semantic.test.ts fail (0 passed, 1 failed; unrelated lexical hit precedes OIDC). Restoring hybridScored passes (1 passed, 0 failed). Tests import TypeScript source directly. Added published model-card query/document prompts and bumped cache input version to v2. Final measured embeddinggemma-2 hybrid recall@1 0.28125, recall@5 0.671875, MRR 0.442726 versus lexical 0.203125, 0.5, 0.332508. Qwen benchmark and independent embedding probe timed out; no Qwen quality claim.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Final design uses direct node:http requests to bypass environment proxies, loopback origin validation, installed local-model checks and model-card query/document prompts. Cache includes a private ignore rule for custom tracker locations. Semantic consolidation stays advisory and refuses apply before writes. Non-git regression removes Git from PATH and blocks ancestor discovery. Isolated health passes; normal-home health reports global pm-github host-version skew against the unchanged pinned host. Existing wall-clock privacy probe failed once under shared load; limits remain unchanged. Linked semantic test timeout is now 600 seconds to accommodate observed host contention.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Review found and fixed a direct-adapter SDK bypass: OllamaProvider.embed now revalidates an installed local model on every call, including calls outside recall, and refuses a changed revision before sending text. Regression confirms cloud aliases and retagged models receive no embedding inputs. Earlier CI at the first feature commit passed 184/184 tests, 2/2 packed consumers and 100/100/100/100 coverage on Node 22/26, including bun run release:check. Superseded the local run after this safety correction; final-head gates are rerunning.

value.author: codex-agent

Restoring the checks passes (1 passed, 0 failed). Focused adapter/cache/ranking suite: 5/5 passed with 100/100/100/100 coverage for src/embeddings.ts. No encoding, ranking weights or benchmark labels changed.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: PR #5 review round: verified unresolved thread PRRT_kwDOVPw2oc6u2YPE. Capture consolidation corpus and lexical proposals under the writer lock, release before loopback embedding HTTP requests, preserve advisory output and lexical apply semantics. Latest CodeRabbit review has no outside-diff findings. Add slow-loopback concurrency regressions and function-only revert proofs; run unchanged npm and Bun release gates with isolated Git identity.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implemented review thread PRRT_kwDOVPw2oc6u2YPE and same-class recall correction. Slow loopback fixture withholds both embedding batches for a 17-memory preview while separate writer processes complete; lexical proposals and captured corpus remain stable and durable bytes change only from those writers. Recall releases the lock for document and query embeddings, retries insertions and content revisions, and atomically increments current counters without retrying counter-only drift. Typecheck, lint and zero-duplication checks passed. Function-only consolidate revert fails its targeted regression (0 passed, 1 failed, exit 1: writer blocked while embedding response is withheld); restored implementation passes (1 passed, 0 failed). Function-only recall revert fails with the same contention assertion (0 passed, 1 failed, exit 1). Final restored recall proof and full unchanged-threshold release gates follow.
